node.statement: Local scalar preservation, independent of node 1.1: let a in U(1) and W in calU. By the definition calU=overline{calU}_0, W^dagger bold-dot W=J and there is R with W bold-dot R=J. Conjugate-linearity of dagger and bilinearity of bold-dot give (aW)^dagger bold-dot(aW)=(conj(a)W^dagger) bold-dot(aW)=conj(a)*a*(W^dagger bold-dot W)=J. Also (aW) bold-dot(conj(a)R)=a*conj(a)*(W bold-dot R)=J, so aW has the explicit right inverse conj(a)R. Therefore aW lies in calU.
